name: Mender
role: healer / priest: sustain, cleanses, the earliest in-combat revive
description: A censer, a holy symbol and the party’s second chance. The Mender heals by the target’s size, cleanses anything, revives mid-fight from level 5, and in the Crypts is a striker, because Holy is what the Restless Dead fear.

schools.name: Benediction
schools.philosophy: Keep them standing. Heals that scale with the target, a Regen that outlasts the fight, a Shield for the one about to be hit, and the revive.

schools.name: Sanctity
schools.philosophy: Holy damage, Smite, wards and Fear. Holy hits either row and hits Undead and Shadow twice as hard; the wards make the front row safe.

schools.name: Vigil
schools.philosophy: Cleanse, steady, gift. The school that makes the other six classes better: debuffs come off, Fortify goes on, Momentum changes hands, and the lantern keeps the Dark away.

aiRuleDefault: IF self HP < 30% THEN item small hp potion on self; IF ally HP < 50% THEN mend on lowest ally; ELSE smite front enemy

visual.notes: A broad, grounded column: a long robe under a knee-length tabard carrying the sunburst, the censer swung low on its chain or the holy symbol raised to put a point of light at shoulder height. The tabard and the low mace keep it apart from the Arcanist at 200px.

pros: Sustain: Mend heals 18% of max HP for 10 Mana at light weight; Circle of Mending heals the whole party
The earliest in-combat revive: Breath of Life at Tier II, level 5
Cleanses everything and hands out Momentum; Holy does about 2× against Undead
cons: Low damage outside Holy targets: Smite on a living bandit is 1.4× of a healer’s spell Attack
Mana-hungry: a full-party emergency is most of a level-7 pool in three turns
Robes and Blunt only: the healer is the target the moment the front row falls
